name: timesheet-logger
description: Always-on-top Windows overlay for planning the week, tracking time against client projects, and exporting Markdown for Cursor to draft customer timesheet notes.
author: mikha.jeon

comments.overrides: node-gyp@9 (pulled in by electron-builder) wants http-proxy-agent@5, whose @tootallnate/once dependency is blocked by the corporate proxy. v7 drops that dependency and is API-compatible; nothing here builds native modules, so node-gyp is never actually exercised.
